name: semantic-file-search
title: Semantic File Search
description: Find local documents, photos, video scenes and sounds by meaning. Requires the Semantic Search Engine.
author: nik_ustinovich

commands.name: semantic-search
commands.title: Search Files
commands.description: Find local files from a natural-language description
commands.subtitle: Semantic File Search

commands.name: automatic-index
commands.title: Check for Library Updates
commands.description: Check the automatic indexing schedule and update changed files when due

preferences.name: serviceURL
preferences.title: Custom Local Service (Optional)
preferences.description: Leave blank to use the installed Semantic Search Engine. Advanced: connect to your own local service.

preferences.name: serviceTokenPath
preferences.title: Custom Service Token File (Optional)
preferences.description: Advanced: authentication file for your custom local service. Leave blank to use shared storage. Accepts an absolute path or ~/ path.
